test_gateway_resolved_cwd_survives: test that a pre-resolved TERMINAL_CWD survives a lazy cli.py import without being clobbered by os.getcwd()
test_gateway_resolved_cwd_survives_with_: test that a pre-resolved TERMINAL_CWD survives even when config.yaml has a terminal section
test_explicit_config_cwd_wins: test that an explicit terminal.cwd from config.yaml overrides any prior TERMINAL_CWD env value
test_dot_cwd_resolves_to_getcwd_when_no_: test that a dot placeholder cwd resolves to os.getcwd() when no prior TERMINAL_CWD is set
test_remote_backend_pops_cwd: test that a remote backend with placeholder cwd removes cwd for backend default behavior
